identity: An offline-first iPhone Home Screen utility that makes Apple Notes-style gym logging easier while keeping Apple Notes as the canonical archive.
purpose: Reduce the interaction cost of maintaining a large Apple Notes workout log without adding accounts, cloud sync, analytics, or generic fitness-platform features.

authoritativeDocs.role: Implementation decisions that preserve the specification
Engineering state, tasks, reviews, evidence, and reports

productChatRole: Product authority and human interface. It can consume the published packet and decide unresolved product questions, but it does not accept worker claims as verification.

bridge.recommendedUpgrade: Put this repository on a source the dedicated ChatGPT project can read, such as a connected GitHub repository or synchronized file location.
bridge.minimumUserAction: Ask the product conversation to read PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md from the connected source, or attach/open that one file if no connector exists.
bridge.why: The current environment has no supported API for injecting a message into an existing ChatGPT conversation, and local Windows paths are not inherently readable by that conversation.
